meta.method: Researched real bath towels and bath sheets (single-towel regular prices, excluding sets/bundles) across US, CA, MX, GB and IE retailers via web search and direct page fetches of brand and retailer sites in October 2026. Each product's name, price and attributes were taken from what a search result snippet or a fetched page actually stated; where only a set price or only a price range was found and no single confirmed per-towel price could be read, that item was left out rather than estimated. Prices reflect what was read at the time of research and may have changed since; several retailers (Target, Macy's, Pendleton, Lands' End, RH) were running sales in October 2026, so both a regular 'price' and, where stated, a discounted 'salePrice' are recorded. Shipping and returns details were not confirmed in this research pass and are marked accordingly. Hudson's Bay was excluded because thebay.com no longer operates as an independent retailer (HBC ceased Canadian retail operations in June 2025; the Hudson's Bay name now exists only as a Canadian Tire house brand), so no current bath-towel page could be read for it.
meta.checked: 2026-10-05: 7 dropped by hand: those not confirmed on the seller’s page, and those priced in another market’s currency (M&S’s and The White Company’s read on their American storefronts).
